why: While a capture waits, the page's pad dispatch stands aside, Back and Pause included, because the button being chosen may be either. Without it, B chosen for Fire is also Back: the pane closes and the capture with it, so Fire can never be moved onto B from a controller.
killedBy: createRouteHost: the gamepad menu poller (issue #494) rebinds Fire onto B from a controller alone, and the B that completes it does not also back out (issue #754)
